| $y$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ |

| ${f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1)$ | $0.1$ | $0.4$ | $0.5$ |

Suppose $X$ and $Y$ are discrete random variables. Find $\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=1]$ given that the conditional probability mass function ${f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1)$ is shown in the table above and the corresponding conditional expected value is ${\mu }_{Y|1}=1.4.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $Y$ given $X=x$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=x] & =\text{E}[(Y-{\mu }_{Y|x})^{2}\,|\,X=x] \\  & =\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=x]-{\mu }_{Y|x}^{2} \\  & =[{\sum }_{y}{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)]-{\mu }_{Y|x}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=1] & =[{\sum }_{y}{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1)]-{\mu }_{Y|1}^{2} \\  & =[(0)^{2}\cdot 0.1+(1)^{2}\cdot 0.4+(2)^{2}\cdot 0.5]-(1.4)^{2} \\  & =0+0.4+2-1.96 \\  & =0.44.\end{aligned}
$$
